evidence: Starting from Upper Caples Valley junction (sign-posted), the track goes uphill through the beech forest.
Once at Steele Creek Hut, the track descends into the forest, windfall might be present until you reach the Greenstone valley.

New Zealand Deer Stalkers Association – Southern Lakes have huts that can be booked by the public at Upper Caples and Mid Greenstone where the Steele Creek track intersects with the main Greenstone Caples tracks.

doubts: Neither end is a road end: the track runs between the Upper Caples Valley junction and its junction with the Greenstone track in the Greenstone valley, so both refs are null (they are junctions on the Caples Track T1 and Greenstone Track T2, but not those tracks themselves). Shape is from DOC's '15 km one way'; the page does not describe a return. Direction of travel recorded as described (Caples to Greenstone); the getting-there notes imply it can be joined from either end. DOC gives no time. McKellar Saddle lies on the access route from The Divide, not on the Steele Creek Track itself.
